description: Versioned baseline for inspectable GenLayer consensus-safety properties. Passing is not formal verification or a security guarantee.

rules.deterministic_core: Require an approved HTTPS source URL pinned to a full commit and an exact canonical SHA-256 match.
Require each validator passed to run_nondet_unsafe to invoke an independent nondeterministic evaluation path.
Check Result/Return and null or error paths around nondeterministic execution.
Check bounds on model-derived enum and range fields.
Trace public value-transfer paths to caller-derived authority guards.
Reject caller-controlled or nondeterministic transfer values and unguarded caller-controlled recipients.
Check that validators independently re-observe external evidence.
Detect untrusted source content entering prompts without explicit evidence framing.
Check HTTPS, URL length, duplicate, and host constraints.
Locate final-state writes relative to consensus and error paths.
Check terminal guards before repeated value settlement.

status_meanings.FAIL: At least one implemented rule found a policy violation.
status_meanings.MEETS_BASELINE: The supplied revision meets the implemented rules only; this is not formal verification or a security guarantee.
status_meanings.UNVERIFIABLE: The analyzer could not establish source identity or obtain the facts required to evaluate a rule.
status_meanings.WARN: No implemented rule failed, but at least one implemented rule produced a bounded warning.
